description: The EMSx dataset: historical photovoltaic and load scenarios and forecasts for 70 industrial sites is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Adrien Le Franc, Marc Ittel (Ecole des Ponts ParisTech). The EMSx dataset gathers a large collection of photovoltaic and load profiles collected by the company Schneider Electric on 70 anonymized industrial sites. This dataset is released as a component of the EMSx benchmark for energy management systems introduced in a sister publication DOI: 10.1007/s12667-020-00417-5 . Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License v1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
